# Coreve — Women-First Luxury Sneakers

> Coreve is an Indian luxury footwear brand designing premium leather sneakers engineered from the ground up for women's anatomy, biomechanics, and everyday comfort.

## Brand Overview
- Website: https://coreve.in
- Legal Entity: Coreve Lifestyle Pvt Ltd
- Headquarters: 17, 2nd Floor, 7th Main Road, 2 Stage Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560038, India
- Philosophy: Women-First Footwear. Coreve creates sneakers built around female anatomy (narrower heel cup, distinct instep arch, natural stride biomechanics), not scaled-down men's lasts.
- Craftsmanship: Italian design sensibilities fused with master Indian footwear craftsmanship and EU standard genuine leather.
- Engineering: Proprietary 65mm heel wedge / 25mm forefoot platform sole delivering posture elevation and poise without the fatigue of heels.
- Cushioning: Adaptive OrthoLite® footbeds that mould to female footprint pressure points.
- Sizing: EU 37–41 (India & UK sizes 4–8). True to size; size up if in between sizes.
- Pricing: ₹6,995 INR (MSRP ₹8,995 INR).
- Payment Methods: 100% Secure Prepaid via UPI, Credit/Debit Cards, and NetBanking on Razorpay. Please note: Cash on Delivery (COD) is NOT available.
- Shipping: Free express shipping across India (2–5 business days in metro cities, 4–7 business days in other areas).
- Exchanges: 7-day hassle-free size exchange for unused sneakers in original packaging.
- Warranty: Queens Club 1-Year Refab Warranty (complimentary upper cleaning, leather conditioning, and sole refurbishment between months 6–12).

## Core Products
- [Cipher Mocha Mousse](https://coreve.in/product/cipher-mocha-mousse-women-sneaker/): Soft, balanced warm mocha tones crafted from EU standard leather with all-day arch support and 65mm wedge lift.
- [Ventra Blue Granite](https://coreve.in/product/ventra-blue-granite-ladies-sneaker-blue-white/): Crisp blue and granite white genuine leather sneaker engineered for calm strength and athletic elegance.
- [Zivana Winterberry](https://coreve.in/product/zivana-winterberry-girl-sneaker-shoe/): Bold berry red and rose accents built for confident, unapologetic daily movement.
- [Elara Tendril](https://coreve.in/product/elara-tendril-ladies-sneaker/): Subtle neutral tones with custom sole moulds designed for effortless versatility from office to weekend.
- [Nyro Eclipse](https://coreve.in/product/nyro-eclipse-women-sneaker-blue-white/): Classic high-contrast monochrome black, eclipse blue, and white leather delivering timeless poise.
